sentences.text: she consumed acid and admitted in the Victoria Hospital, District Jabalpur.
The 164 statement of the prosecutrix was also recorded, wherein she has reiterated her earlier statement before the Police.
However, today the prosecutrix is before this Court stating the she has not given any such statement and no offence has been committed with her.
Further she stated that she has no objection if the bail is granted to the present applicant.
Considering the statement given by the prosecutrix in this Court, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Since, the prosecutrix has herself admitted that she has filed a false complaint and gave false statement before the Magistrate, Police may take action against her in accordance with law.
